snapshot_status_scope: Commit/push flags describe the measured source and decision at the time of the benchmark, before the subsequent follow-up commit.
title: Grid-only versus grid plus ratios with shared existing Ratio-map child prefilter

source.grid_prefilter_enabled: Reuse non-None precomputed_ratio_intervals in grid-only depth>1 without generating ratio query candidates or additional intervals.

source_patch.description: Grid-only forwards an already computed Ratio-interval map at higher depths; query candidate sets remain unchanged.

protocol.order: Sequential fresh processes; alternate both/grid order by repeat and problem ordinal.
protocol.timing_scope: Unchanged solve_problem wall time, including session/worker startup and shutdown and query progress output; imports, input parsing and output serialization excluded. Pool-shutdown observer records worker PIDs; its small common overhead is not separately quantified.

inputs.origin: Exact ten primary 5x5 inputs from previous benchmarks; no new RNG draws.

validation.scope: Chosen trajectory and recorded state results; unchosen recursive branches are not recorded.

historical_semantic_comparison.scope: All 60 current recorded semantic results versus the matching historical first-repeat policy result; excludes only timing and cache fields.
historical_semantic_comparison.timing_caveat: Historical wall times belong to a separate earlier run and are not a causal paired estimate of the prefilter optimization.

initial_query_diagnostics.scope: Separate untimed diagnostic after all 60 solves; only the initial unanswered state of each problem.

full_diagnostic.scope: Only initial, unanswered states; a separate diagnostic after all 60 timed solves. No phase profiling or end-to-end solver is active. Later states have different grids/candidate counts.

receipt.scope: Complete multistep suite after guarded grid prefilter parity change plus four new regression tests.

raw_artifacts.path_convention: All raw_files fields and sha256 keys are relative to root_relative_to_repository. Historical references have their separately recorded root.

limitations: Ten fixed problems from one seed; three timing repeats do not create thirty independent problems.
Both policies use the guarded precomputed Ratio-map forwarding patch; the earlier historical run lacked this path for grid-only.
Historical timing differences are not a fresh paired estimate of the map-forwarding optimization.
This strategy comparison can change chosen queries and terminal confidence; it does not promise universal semantic equality.
99% volume-confidence stopping does not universally guarantee the true target winner.
No detailed profiling is active; candidate-count attribution and phase costs are not measured here.
The untimed Ratio-map parity and query-count diagnostic covers initial unanswered states only.
Recorded semantic equality excludes unchosen recursive planning branches.
The source label includes the uncommitted patch; this document records the local checkpoint without a commit or push.

receipt.mode: Independent read-only review; no new tests, SSH, or benchmark runs.
scope_limits: Recorded chosen trajectories; unchosen recursive branches not recorded.
Separate map diagnosis covers initial states only.
Historical timing differences do not identify a causal prefilter speedup.
